cues: Omega cubed is one, so reduce any power modulo three.
One plus omega plus omega squared is zero, the most useful line in the unit: so one plus omega is minus omega squared, and so on.
Omega squared is the conjugate of omega and also its reciprocal.
And they factorise a cubed plus b cubed plus c cubed minus three a b c.
